lines.text: Jehoshaphat returned safely to Jerusalem, and Jehu the seer rebuked him for helping the wicked but praised him for removing the Asherah poles.
Jehoshaphat went out among the people from Beersheba to the hill country of Ephraim and turned them back to the LORD.
He appointed judges in each fortified city of Judah and told them they were judging for the king.
In Jerusalem he appointed Levites, priests, and family heads to judge, and told them to warn people so they would not incur guilt.
Zebadiah the chief priest was over all matters of the LORD, and Amariah was over all matters of the king.
